RED Komodo-X.rolling_shutter_assessment: Zero rolling shutter artifacts. Completely immune to jello on whip-pans, vibration, strobe lights, and fast-spinning objects.
RED Komodo-X.usable_exposure_latitude: 9 to 10 stops above noise floor in REDCODE RAW (HQ/MQ/LQ)

dual_native_base_iso.high_base: Single base architecture with dynamic dual-stage sensor readout

thermal_management.cooling_type: Active forced-air blower with integrated heatsink
thermal_management.thermal_protocol: Sensor calibration (black shading) check required if ambient operating temperature shifts by more than 15°C.

Sony FX3 / FX3A.rolling_shutter_assessment: Extremely fast readout speed for a full-frame sensor. Very low rolling shutter distortion.
Sony FX3 / FX3A.usable_exposure_latitude: 12.4 to 12.5 stops at SNR=2 in S-Log3 / S-Gamut3.Cine

thermal_management.cooling_type: Active internal cooling fan with graphite heatsink & vapor chamber
thermal_management.thermal_protocol: Practically unlimited continuous 4K 60p recording without thermal shutdown even at 40°C ambient.

DJI Ronin 4D 6K.rolling_shutter_assessment: Moderate rolling shutter readout, mitigated on set by the integrated 4-axis mechanical stabilization.
DJI Ronin 4D 6K.usable_exposure_latitude: 13.1 stops at SNR=2 in ProRes RAW / ProRes 422 HQ

thermal_management.cooling_type: Active body fan with motor temperature sensors
thermal_management.thermal_protocol: Preheat TB50 batteries below 15°C prior to gimbal balance auto-tune.

Sony A7 IV.rolling_shutter_assessment: High rolling shutter in 4K Full Frame mode (26.8ms). Fast whip-pans show pronounced jello distortion. Super35 crop cuts readout in half (13.0ms).

thermal_management.thermal_protocol: Set Auto Power OFF Temp to HIGH. Mandatory to keep LCD screen articulated away from body during continuous 4K 60p takes over 45 minutes.

Blazar Mantis 1.33x Anamorphic Primes.aspect_ratio_pairing: Native 16:9 sensor desqueezes perfectly to 2.39:1 cinematic widescreen with zero vertical crop and 100% sensor area utilization.
Blazar Mantis 1.33x Anamorphic Primes.optical_character: Subtle cylindrical distortion, controlled horizontal blue flares, oval bokeh highlights.
Blazar Mantis 1.33x Anamorphic Primes.autofocus_compatibility: Compatible with LiDAR wireless focus systems (DJI Focus Pro) due to linear 1.33x throw.

Great Joy 1.8x Anamorphic Primes.aspect_ratio_pairing: Optimized for Open Gate 3:2 / 4:3 or RED Komodo 6:5 format. Yields 2.39:1 widescreen after 1.8x desqueeze.
Great Joy 1.8x Anamorphic Primes.optical_character: Pronounced vintage oval bokeh, strong horizontal streak flares (amber/blue), noticeable cinematic breathing.
Great Joy 1.8x Anamorphic Primes.monitoring_requirement: On-set monitor must support 1.8x de-squeeze preview (Accsoon M7 or Desview S14-HDR).

CHIOPT XTREME 28-85mm & 75-250mm T3.2 Zo.optical_design: True Parfocal (maintains focus through entire focal length range)
CHIOPT XTREME 28-85mm & 75-250mm T3.2 Zo.rigging_mandate: MANDATORY 15mm baseplate rod support. Stiff focus throw requires high-torque wireless motors (Tilta Nucleus-M or DJI Focus Pro motor on High setting).

NiSi Athena Cine Primes.aperture: T1.9 across main set (14mm to 85mm), T2.4 on 135mm
NiSi Athena Cine Primes.optical_design: Micro-contrast optimized, matched gear positions across entire focal range, drop-in rear filter slot.
